title: exists local lift overMap from finiteFree
statement:
Let p:M→N be an epimorphism of module sheaves on the slice C/U of a ringed site, and let g be a map from a finite biproduct of rank-one free modules into N. After a covering sieve of U, the restriction of g lifts across the restriction of p. Assume abelian sheafification and local-bijectivity comparisons on every slice.

Precise quantified statement:
theorem exists_local_lift_overMap_from_finiteFree
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    [∀ U : C, HasSheafify (J.over U) AddCommGrpCat.{max u v}]
    [∀ U : C, (J.over U).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max u v}]
    (R : Sheaf J RingCat.{max u v}) (U : C)
    (M N : SheafOfModules.{max u v} (R.over U))
    (p : M ⟶ N) [Epi p] (n : ℕ)
    (g : (⨁ fun _ : Fin n ↦ unit (R.over U)) ⟶ N) :
    ∃ S : Sieve U, S ∈ J U ∧ ∀ (V : C) (f : V ⟶ U), S f →
      ∃ h : (overMap.{max u v} R f).obj
          (⨁ fun _ : Fin n ↦ unit (R.over U)) ⟶ (overMap R f).obj M,
        h ≫ (overMap R f).map p = (overMap R f).map g

Notions used: [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-pur-localized-ringed-site].

proof.text: Forget the epimorphism to abelian sheaves and use local surjectivity at the terminal object of the slice for each finite generator. Intersect their covering image sieves. Extend the lifted sections naturally over each new slice, assemble them using the preserved biproduct colimit, and verify the required equation on all coprojections.
